product.title: Downtown Austin Giant Paddleboard Sunset Tour with Bats

description.text: In Austin, paddle a giant board with your private group of up to six on Lady Bird Lake at sunset. Watch the Austin skyline glow, then position for the Congress Avenue Bridge bat emergence before returning to shore with life jackets, paddles, and a dry cooler provided. Stops include Lady Bird Lake Launch, Austin Skyline, Congress Avenue Bridge, Bat Colony Viewing. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Austin skyline views, lake corridors, and Hill Country highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Austin who want a guided Capital City experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
